hook: Three proud Knights hold their stations alone; you choose what fills the ground between, and heirs wake when elders fall.
loop: Hold the Lek: Knights on F1, B2, F4, never next to each other.
Gallery units or empty ground grow three giant Knights permanently.
In the fight, champions double and heirs Take Station when elders fall.

growth.line: Permanent End of Turn buffs pile onto three Knights; in the fight they double or heirs inherit.

feel.early: Lone tempo Knights, cheap hens, waiting Squires.
feel.mid: Placement puzzle; shops show Knights you can't field.
feel.late: Doubled champions, or breaking the lek with Ottokar.

stars.why: Doubles while alone: empty ground becomes a real choice.
Doubles the biggest Knight, then leaves; with Einsiedel that's x4.
Losing an elder mid-fight turns into permanent growth for the heir.

card_short.u01: More Attack for each empty slot beside it.
card_short.u02: Squire heir: grows permanently each time it Takes Station.
card_short.u03: End of Turn: buffs other Knights, more beside its Gallery.
card_short.u04: Start of Combat: drains Attack from its Gallery into itself.
card_short.u05: Watcher: gold next turn if touching two Knights.
card_short.u06: Deaf: always on Station; attacks twice once a fight.
card_short.u07: Squire heir: takes half the fallen elder's stats permanently.
card_short.u08: Watcher: End of Turn, big buff to biggest Knight beside.
card_short.u09: Start of Combat: blasts the enemy across and its own neighbours.
card_short.u10: End of Turn: buffs other Knights per empty slot beside it.
card_short.u11: End of Turn: permanently buffs each of its Gallery units.
card_short.u12: Only Knights beside, not in front or behind, blank yours.
card_short.u13: Watcher: your Takes Station effects trigger twice.
card_short.u14: Double Attack and Health while nothing stands next to it.
card_short.u15: Gains, for the fight, the stats of neighbours that die.
card_short.u16: Non-Knights next to it trigger End of Turn twice.
card_short.u17: Your Knights not next to it are always on Station.
card_short.u18: Watcher: Start of Combat, doubles biggest Knight beside, then leaves.
card_short.u19: Squire heir: Takes Station gives all your Knights +5/+5 permanently.

builds.name: The Full Lek
builds.line: Watchers fill the ground; hens pay gold, Herald doubles them.

builds.name: The Bare Ridge
builds.line: Few huge Knights, empty ground; Einsiedel and Dame Reisig hit x4.

builds.name: The Battery Gallery
builds.line: Charge other tribes' units, drain them, then Brennbart blows them up.

liked: Dame Reisig doubles Einsiedel, then leaves him alone to double again.
Station rechecks mid-fight: heirs wake, and no tribe today plays like it.
worries: Heather Hen gold: four around Herald of the Old Lek pay 8 a turn.
Watch Ottokar's crowd, and golden Rupprecht or Roost-Pine Squire with golden Chronicler.
changed: Every card now says Knight or Watcher, so the Lek reads off cards.
Three heirs now print Squire, so they no longer blank their elder.
Pennon-Bearer now gives more to Knights next to its Gallery.
verdict: Board-placement puzzlers get three proud Knights to guard, the ground between them to fill, and heirs to wake.
